description: acp-cli — consume ACP coding agents directly from the CLI. Send prompts, create sessions, stream completions from 35+ ACP agents (Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, Cline, Goose, Codex, Kilo, Junie, Qwen, Mistral, Kimi, OpenCode). Implements the Agent Communication Protocol JSON-RPC client over stdio.
